title: QA run · release-18.1.0-manual-set (15/15) · 77392e90 · 2026-10-23 · 12 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
This record covers the 18.1.0 release sweep's manual non-P0 set, run on the same `main` head as the P0 manual re-test (QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#25478). The set uses the sweep rule: the `since:v18` items with no automated pin, plus the manual P1 items that the breaking commits since the last P0 sweep touched. Those commits cover cloud-managed sign-up and invite refusal, the REST `/actions` and MCP action channel, settings D9, metadata rollback and flow `get_record` limits, together with objectui's approval record page, CSV import and bulk `confirmText`. The set was named by hand rather than resolved by a single selector, and every item it names has a verdict (15/15).

## Environment fingerprint

- framework `77392e901cce58316e803144971f2741ef049fc4`. `.objectui-sha` is `5fef032b1ada5b86bad640637e7331e26ee5da6e`.
- tree, console and container are the same as the P0 record. The console deviation applies here too: the console was built at the same pin from a sibling worktree at `f0fdd45b`, because `pnpm objectui:build` at the pin fails on this `main` (#25438). The stamp equals the pin.
- boots: stock showcase, one port range and file DB per runner, with `OS_PORT` exported. `platform-core.marketplace-install-local-lifecycle` and `cli.fresh-install-migrate-apply-first` booted from a scratch copy under `examples/`, which was deleted afterwards. `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` never existed.
- execution: three runner agents (CLI/API · identity/settings/studio · approvals/actions/UX). `git status` stayed clean.

## Scope and verdicts

None of the 15 items carries an `automated.ref`, so every clause was driven live.

| item | priority | rev | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| cli.fresh-install-migrate-apply-first | P1 | 1 | PASS |
| ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate | P1 | 4 | PASS |
| platform-core.marketplace-install-local-lifecycle | P1 | 8 | PASS |
| automation.flow-node-type-matrix | P1 | 9 | PASS |
| identity-auth.first-run-owner-bootstrap | P1 | 3 | PASS |
| identity-auth.self-signup-gate | P1 | 6 | PASS |
| identity-auth.org-membership-team-management | P1 | 5 | PASS |
| identity-auth.self-service-profile-password | P1 | 2 | PASS |
| platform-core.settings-hub-roundtrip | P1 | 5 | PASS |
| studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle | P1 | 8 | PASS |
| approvals.record-page-decisions | **P2** | 4 | **FAIL** (negative[1]) |
| approvals.decision-action-matrix | P1 | 8 | PARTIAL (A9 blocked(fixture), knownGaps[0]) |
| approvals.inbox-metadata-actions | P1 | 5 | PASS |
| records-forms.action-location-matrix | P1 | 14 | PARTIAL (A3 fail-closed half not consultable on stock; A4 half (a) blocked(fixture), knownGaps) |
| ux-conventions.write-feedback | P1 | 4 | PASS (#24570's kanban live-region FAIL no longer reproduces) |

**Derived: 12 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.**

## Per-clause evidence (one line per clause)

### cli.fresh-install-migrate-apply-first
- A0 pass: `os migrate apply --yes` exits 0, reporting 107 tables. One `adr-0131-organization-ownership` birth marker exists (shape generation 1), and it is byte-identical after boot.
- A1 pass: `os serve` reports production, ready, with no DEGRADED line. Health and ready both return 200, and 0 refusal lines appear.

### ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate
- A0 pass: unexposed `showcase_mark_done` is refused with the opt-in prescription, and the task is unchanged (admin and Mei).
- A1 pass: `list_actions` returns only `showcase_portfolio_snapshot`.
- A2 pass: the exposed action returns counts equal to REST totals.
- A3 pass: the TRUSTED audit line names the user.
- A4 pass: `objectName:'sys_user'` is refused by the system-object guard.

### platform-core.marketplace-install-local-lifecycle
- A0 pass: boot A mounts the proxy (502 without egress) and boot B (`OS_CLOUD_URL=off`) answers 404 on catalog routes. The catalog branch then answers 503 without dialing out.
- A1 pass: runtime-config agrees.
- A2 pass: the CRM artifact installs and `crm_app` is served.
- A3 pass: members see the entry without `installedBy` or `storageDir`; anonymous gets 401.
- A4 pass: purge 28 → re-purge skipped 28 → restart durable → reseed 28.
- A5 pass: members get 403 and anonymous 401 on all four writes.
- A6 pass: uninstall withdraws objects (404) before and after a restart.

### automation.flow-node-type-matrix
- A0 pass: the feed has 19 types, matching the palette.
- A1 pass: every type is exercised with a success step. http was exercised via a self-ping, since Slack egress is denied.
- A2 pass: screen, wait, approval, approval_revise, map and subflow each pause, then complete.
- A3 pass: 90 steps, 0 with an empty nodeType.
- A4 pass: loop-body, parallel-branch and try/catch regions are present.
- A5 pass: `bogus_node` is saved with a WARN naming `unknownTypes`, and the run fails with `NO_EXECUTOR`.

### identity-auth.first-run-owner-bootstrap
- A0 pass: `hasOwner` goes from false to true.
- A1 pass: the wizard sign-up returns 200 under `disableSignUp:true`.
- A2 pass: the org is renamed to `测试组织🚀`, and still has 1 row.
- A3 pass: a full reload lands on home.
- A4 pass: forged sign-ups get 400 `EMAIL_PASSWORD_SIGN_UP_DISABLED` / 403 `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`, with no row created.
- A5 pass: `/setup` shows no wizard for anonymous or the owner.

### identity-auth.self-signup-gate
- A0 pass: `invite_only` is published.
- A1 pass: uninvited sign-up gets 403 `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` and no row.
- A2 pass: invited sign-up returns 200 and get-session works.
- A3 pass: on the disabled boot, `/register` redirects to login with no Sign up link.
- A4 pass: on the disabled boot, invited sign-up gets 400 and uninvited gets 403.

### identity-auth.org-membership-team-management
- A0 pass: the org record page has the Members/Invitations/Teams tabs and row actions.
- A1 pass: the invite right follows the role (403 → admin 200 → member 403).
- A2 pass: off-vocabulary roles get 400 `ROLE_NOT_FOUND`.
- A3 pass: rename round-trips.
- A4 pass: remove-member returns 200, the old session gets 401 (`organization_membership_ended`), and re-sign-in gets 403 on the org.
- A5 pass: team members are recorded uniquely; a generic POST gets 405.
- A6 pass: a forger gets 403 on every management door, and state is unchanged.

### identity-auth.self-service-profile-password
- A0 pass: a name change persists across a reload.
- A1 pass: the avatar goes presign → PUT → complete → update-user, and the image is a real `/storage/files/` URL.
- A2 pass: removing the avatar nulls the image.
- A3 pass: the new password signs in and the old one gets 401.
- A4 pass: a wrong current password gets 400 `INVALID_PASSWORD`, and nothing changes.
- A5 pass: a no-password user sets an initial password, then signs in.

### platform-core.settings-hub-roundtrip
- A0–A1 pass: the timezone PUT reaches `me/localization`, and a datetime renders +9h.
- A2 pass: an audit row is written.
- A3 pass: the override badge persists.
- A4–A5 pass: an env lock gets 409 `SETTINGS_LOCKED` and the UI shows a disabled "Locked by env".
- A6 pass: mail test reports honest failures.
- A7–A8 pass: secrets live in `sys_secret` and read back masked, with no plaintext anywhere.
- A9 pass: the env-locked secret is masked and refuses a PUT.
- A10 pass: an echoed mask is a no-op. This was proven with a fake SMTP AUTH that still carries the original value.
- A11 pass: anonymous gets 401, including with forged headers.
- A12 pass: all 11 namespaces serve.

### studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle
- A0 pass: a draft is invisible to runtime.
- A1–A2 pass: publish serves, and a staged draft does not leak.
- A3 pass: a stale OCC token gets 409 `METADATA_CONFLICT`.
- A4 pass: publish-drafts is atomic on refusal.
- A5 pass: a stray key gets 422 at draft save; a dangling dataset gets 422 at publish.
- A6 pass: the Studio draft indicator clears after publish.
- A7 pass: history is ordered.
- A8 pass: the diff names `widgets` only.
- A9 pass: rollback to v1 is served to Mei.
- A10–A11 pass: the audit actor is the authenticated admin, and `X-Actor` is ignored.

### approvals.record-page-decisions
The surface is the showcase_project record page with the DeclaredActionsBar.
- A0 pass: the bar shows Approve, Reject, Reassign, Send back, Request info, Recall and Reply in order, with declared testids.
- A1 pass: Reject opens exactly 1 dialog; Confirm sends `POST …/reject` with the comment, 200.
- A2 pass: the reject and approve re-reads carry the comment, and the POST names the request id.
- A3 pass: the admin sees the record editable under manager_review and locked ("Locked for approval") under exec_review.
- A4 pass: the member's approvals read returns `[]`, 0 actions render, and a forged approve gets 403. With the admin off the slate, only the Override variants render.
- N0 and N2 pass.
- **N1 FAIL:** on the same lockRecord:true request (exec_review), the step-9 member (a contributor who reads the project but is not on the slate) is offered inline edit: 12 double-click affordances, Edit enabled, no lock band. Saving answers `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_project/ID {"health":"yellow"}` → 409 `RECORD_LOCKED`. Reproduced on 3 fresh loads; the admin sees the lock on the same record. Extracted as its own card. Reproduction rule:
  1. As admin, mint a contributor member: `invite-member`, then sign-up, then `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position {user_id, position:'contributor', organization_id}`.
  2. As admin, `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_project/ID {"budget":600000}`.
  3. `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/MGR/approve`. The new exec_review row reads `lock_record:true`.
  4. As the member, use a form sign-in and open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_project/record/ID`.
  5. Expected: no inline-edit affordance. Actual: Edit is enabled and fields are double-click editable; save → 409 `RECORD_LOCKED`.

### approvals.decision-action-matrix
- A0–A8 pass: each action appends exactly one row. Approve and reject branches reach their terminal states. Revise returns a request that is then resubmitted as a new round, and the third revise auto-rejects. Recall is by the submitter only. Reassign, remind, request-info and comment leave state unchanged. Lock gets 409 `RECORD_LOCKED` under exec_review only.
- A9 blocked(fixture): no org-less request can be provisioned on stock (knownGaps[0]).
- Negatives held: revise at exec_review gets 400; a second remind gets 429 `THROTTLED`; a non-participant gets 403 on every door.

### approvals.inbox-metadata-actions
The surface is the account-app inbox; rows open the served record page.
- A0 pass: a non-override approver gets the full page with the declared set.
- A1 pass: the submitter, approver and override sets differ as declared.
- A2 pass: the viewer flags predict the rendered set exactly.
- A3–A4 pass: approve and remind from the page land 200, and exactly one action row is appended each.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#25227's blank page does not reproduce.

### records-forms.action-location-matrix
- A0 pass: all six hosts render their declared actions.
- A1 pass: no extra placements.
- A2 pass: bulk_reassign screen flow, quick_view modal, mark_done, log_time routed page, open_docs popup (egress-blocked target) and recalc_selection all work.
- A3 partial: the both-sides half passes (Mark Done vs Reopen). The fail-closed half is not consultable, because no throwing predicate ships on stock.
- A4: half (a) is blocked(fixture) (no locations-less packaged specimen); half (b) passes.

### ux-conventions.write-feedback
- A0 pass: every landed write showed feedback paired with a server read. Covered: create, inline edit, bulk delete, kanban move, Mark Done, invite, approval decision, import, Studio autosave/publish/discard, and settings save.
- A1–A2 pass: messages name the subject, and declared messages are verbatim.
- A3 pass: a refused kanban move gives an error toast, the card reverts, and the live region announces the refusal with no "Moved" claim.
- A4 pass: a no-op edit sends no PATCH.
- A5 pass: background import Undo works (update and create modes).

## Findings outside the clauses

Product defects are extracted at close-out; see the closing comment. Two runners independently observed one authorization-adjacent behavior on the approvals doors, low severity: **detail withheld pending maintainer**.

Low, not extracted:
- `sys_setting_audit.old_hash` is always null.
- A dev-seed audit row has a null actor.
- `GET /approvals/requests/ID/actions` answers 200 `[]` where `GET /approvals/requests/ID` answers 404 for a non-participant; nothing leaks.
- MCP `run_action` accepts undeclared `params` silently.
- `OS_CLOUD_URL=off`'s catalog refusal says "not configured".
- `admin/create-user` answers `membershipCreated:false` while a member row exists.

## Checklist-accuracy findings and fixture gaps (not extracted)

**approvals:**
- inbox-metadata-actions steps 2/3/6 and A0, and write-feedback variants[6], still say "drawer". Decisions are taken on the served record page.
- record-page-decisions: A3 names only the admin while negative[1] is unscoped. The bar offers Send back at exec_review, which the server refuses with 400: a predicate cannot see revise edges.
- decision-action-matrix: the approve branch logs `exec_review` as `skipped`.
- A fresh persona's positions appear only after re-reading get-session.

**ux-conventions.write-feedback:**
- knownGaps[3] and A5 "no stock surface offers Undo" are stale: background import offers Undo.
- A contributor sees only tasks whose `assignee` is their own email.
- A1 needs a ruling on object-only strings ("Task created successfully", "Settings saved").

**records-forms.action-location-matrix:**
- The related-list header renders list_toolbar actions.
- The Log Time page heading shows the machine name `showcase_task.form`.

**platform-core.settings-hub-roundtrip:**
- `variants` lists 10 namespaces against 11 elsewhere (`lifecycle`).
- The Mars/Phobos code is `value_domain`, not `invalid_option`.
- No stock user-scope namespace carries secrets.

**studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle:**
- The code reads `METADATA_CONFLICT` in the body.
- The draft OCC token is the draft head's version.
- A stray key is now refused at draft save.
- `diffShallow` is top-level only.

**cli.fresh-install-migrate-apply-first:**
- The first serve adds a second `sys_migration` row (`adr-0093-membership-backfill`).
- The apply prints an expected-noise WARN about `sys_metadata_activation`.

**automation.flow-node-type-matrix:**
- clone needs both `name` and `label`.

**identity-auth.self-signup-gate:**
- The disabled-signup boot can be the bootstrap item's post-bootstrap boot.

## Off-clause probe line (rule 8)

About 35 runner-minutes. Personas: admin, Mei, contributor and approver personas, a forger, a no-password user, and anonymous.

**Doors and boundary classes:**
- MCP `run_action`: empty, unknown and case-variant inputs.
- Automation runs: limit boundary values and unknown flow/run ids.
- install-local: double purge.
- Sign-up: six concurrent bootstrap sign-ups, which yielded exactly one owner.
- Rollback/diff: boundary values.
- Draft-peek params as Mei.
- Settings as a member.
- Role vocabulary.
- set-initial-password re-use.
- update-user email.
- Approvals POST family: unknown and empty ids and `to`, empty comment.

**Found and extracted:**
- rollback coerces `toVersion`;
- publish-drafts reports a false error-tier probe;
- reassign accepts a nonexistent principal;
- `GET /automation/<unknown>/runs` answers 200 `[]` where trigger answers 404 (in the unknown-resource family card).

## Handover

None. Every item has a verdict.
